name: Round the clock operation
description: Front desk, PMS and payments run every hour of every day, so maintenance windows are short and incidents often happen when IT staff are absent.

name: Seasonal and outsourced staff
description: Many users are seasonal, agency or outsourced workers who start on a live shift and leave at short notice.

name: Shared devices
description: Front desk, outlet and back office terminals are shared across shifts and roles.

name: Multi property operation
description: Several properties run under one group with separate directories, uneven builds and local IT support.

name: Franchise or managed operation
description: Brand, operator, owner and franchisee split accountability while vendors run many core systems.

name: Mixed guest data
description: Card data, identity documents, guest registers, folios, loyalty profiles and CCTV sit in one estate under several legal regimes.

name: Operational override
description: Operations teams override IT rules to protect the guest experience when security and service collide.
